design_notes: Use hairline rules to separate the financials table and sidebar; the pull-quote should be set in a larger serif with a left rule in the accent colour.
No imagery; the pull-quote and tables carry the visual weight.

pull_quotes.after_paragraph: One relationship frames everything else in this filing.
pull_quotes.quote: Indian Railways is the company's largest customer, contributing 57% of revenue in FY2018, and Western Railway alone accounts for 52% of the orders on hand.
pull_quotes.rationale: Customer concentration is the single most important fact about this company; a pull-quote forces the reader to confront it.

sidebars.body_markdown: The issue comprises 44,28,000 equity shares of ₹10 each, to be listed on the SME Board.[^drhp-p29] The issue price is not yet set.[^drhp-p29] Lead manager: Mark Corporate Advisors Private Limited; registrar: Bigshare Services Private Limited.[^drhp-p31] Of the proceeds, ₹1,130 lakh is earmarked for working capital; the amount for general corporate purposes is not disclosed.[^drhp-p48] The DRHP does not state whether the shares are a fresh issue, an offer for sale, or a mix — an item to verify in the full filing.[^drhp-p29]
sidebars.rationale: A compact sidebar gives the reader the essential offer mechanics without breaking the narrative flow.
sidebars.title: The offer at a glance

tables.after_paragraph: The five-year restated financial story is one of a business getting smaller
tables.rationale: The five-year trend of shrinking revenue and rising short-term debt is the core financial story; a table makes the divergence and debt shift immediately visible.
